item: The top-bar Wikipedia toggle states its state and its click starts a held stream
status: shipped (browser-verified in the remote sandbox; awaiting the human UX pass)
summary: The W in the top bar is the stream switch, not the walk's; it drew a chosen-but-held stream like a live one and a click paused something not running. A corner pip now draws live/held/waiting/paused/stopped by shape; the hover names the page walk's state; a click on a held stream starts it; the bar and Settings repaint on a network crossing and when the walk box is saved.
